_comment: Drift-to-canonical label mapping for the Phase 1 bootstrap annotator's output.  Keys are the labels Claude has emitted; values are the canonical label.  Absent labels are identity (already canonical).  Maintained by hand: open the annotation.conf produced by bin/brat_export after each bootstrap run, eyeball drift pairs (same anatomy, different label string), and add them here.  Consumed by notebooks/heaps_law_analysis.ipynb (computes drift fraction) and any future canonicalization Pass.  Rule (2026-08-17): prefer the more idiomatic form, settled by counting occurrences in CANONICAL space (a canonical-only target like "Cultural characteristics" occurs zero times literally). Pairs deliberately NOT merged, and the reasoning, are in docs/feature_label_non_synonyms.md.
_note_rules: Some drift is rule-shaped and settled once instead of entry by entry: treatments_to_structured/feature_label_rules.py normalises the sexual/asexual head noun (morph/stage/state/phase, glued or spaced) and decomposes growth-condition qualifiers (Colony on MEA -> (Colony, MEA)) without merging them, per the "never collapse this family" rule in docs/feature_label_non_synonyms.md.  This map wins wherever both apply, because its entries record human decisions.  Both rules are pinned against this map (positive controls) and against every recorded non-synonym pair (negative controls) in feature_label_rules_test.py.
_note_brat_safe: As of 2026-06-29, parse_claude_response strips parens/commas/periods at parse time (treatments_to_structured.brat_render.brat_safe_type) so the candidate DB never sees them.  Entries below cover (1) drift in the post-sanitization vocabulary like Odor vs Odour, and (2) legacy labels still present in the candidate DB from earlier runs that predate the sanitization.
